title: A start the NPC roster stopped (<game>/kiln/state/roster-refused.json), format 1
description: Written by kiln.knowledge (0.2.0-dev.29) when the mods' NPC roster cannot be held (more than 128 entries, or more than 64 where Kiln's second unlock page cannot be installed): before the log line, before kiln.boot's stop writes boot.json and progress.json, and before any message box, so a reader has the reason even when the player ends the game while the message is open. The process then ends with exitCode. The next start of Kiln moves the file to roster-refused.last.json (a reader of the last stop reads that one). A stale file is told by pid and utc. docs/kiln/launcher/contracts.md, docs/kiln/services/npcs.md.

why.description: The build's refusal, word for word: "the roster holds at most 128 NPCs (two 64-bit unlock pages): 35 of the game's + 94 new", or the 64 text with "(the second unlock page is not available here: <why>)". Show it to the player.

mods.description: The mods that add roster NPCs (ids): the ones to remove or update.

exitCode.description: 0x4B02 (KILN_KNOW_ROSTER_EXIT_CODE), the code the process ends with.

unixExitStatus.description: What a Linux parent sees when the server runs under Wine (the low byte).

restart.description: A restart stops the same way: nothing should restart the game or the server on this exit.

advice.description: What to do, one paragraph, the same as in kiln.log.

bootStop.description: kiln.boot's stop_start ended the start: boot.json "boot"."stop" and progress.json (state failed) say the same. false: an older core without that call; then only this file and kiln.log.

pid.description: The game process, as boot.json's pid.
